app.name: prism-uorc
app.title: Prism UORC
app.purpose: Decides whether one object may be kept in, or opened from, the owner's browser as a UORC archive (UOR-Foundation/compression): the archive is the object's reference, a lossless executable structure sealed by UORC-SHA256-CHAIN-v1, named by the kappa label of the bytes it restores. The decision reads only the archive's structure (its seal, format, scope, object count, whether it restored to the very bytes its label names, and the kappa facet's answer), never the content: values are projected only when the decision says open.

fields.name: act
fields.means: keep: the vault is about to keep the object as this archive; open: the vault is about to give the object back from this archive

fields.name: seal
fields.means: the archive's UORC-SHA256-CHAIN-v1 integrity seal checks (inspect's integrity_ok), read without decoding

fields.name: format
fields.means: the archive's format and machine profile are the ones the pinned client writes (format 2, profile 1)

fields.name: scope
fields.means: self-contained; conditional on the standard basis the pinned client carries (named by its identity in site/uorc/uorc.lock.json); or conditional on any other basis, which the browser does not hold

fields.name: objects
fields.means: the archive restores exactly one object, the one its kappa label names

fields.name: restore
fields.means: the archive decoded within the client's work bound to the very bytes its kappa label names (same), to other bytes, or not at all

fields.name: kappa
fields.means: the kappa facet's answer for the restored bytes under their label: admit, or anything else

meanings.keep: the archive is kept as the object's reference
meanings.open: the archive's values are projected for the owner
meanings.refuse: the archive is neither kept nor opened

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when seal is broken then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when format is other then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when scope is other then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when objects is many then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when restore is differs then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when restore is failed then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when kappa is other then refuse
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when act is keep then keep
rules.why: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path to keep

app.otherwiseWhy: Prism UORC: the decision tree's path that meets no test

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: the kill switch stops every keep and open

properties.says: always when seal is broken then refuse
properties.why: an archive whose seal does not check is no reference

properties.says: always when format is other then refuse
properties.why: only the pinned client's format and profile are read

properties.says: always when scope is other then refuse
properties.why: an archive conditional on a basis the browser does not hold cannot be checked here

properties.says: always when objects is many then refuse
properties.why: one archive is one object under one kappa label

properties.says: always when restore is differs then refuse
properties.why: an archive that restores other bytes than its label names is never kept or opened

properties.says: always when restore is failed then refuse
properties.why: an archive that does not decode within the work bound is never kept or opened

properties.says: always when kappa is other then refuse
properties.why: an object the kappa facet did not admit has no reference in the Prism

properties.says: never when act is keep then open
properties.why: keeping never projects the object's values

properties.says: never when act is open then keep
always when act is keep and halted is no and seal is ok and format is known and scope is standard and objects is one and restore is same and kappa is admit then keep
properties.why: a sound archive of an admitted object is kept

properties.says: always when act is open and halted is no and seal is ok and format is known and scope is standard and objects is one and restore is same and kappa is admit then open
properties.why: a sound archive of an admitted object is opened

properties.says: always when act is keep and halted is no and seal is ok and format is known and scope is self and objects is one and restore is same and kappa is admit then keep
properties.why: a sound archive of an admitted object is kept

properties.says: always when act is open and halted is no and seal is ok and format is known and scope is self and objects is one and restore is same and kappa is admit then open
properties.why: a sound archive of an admitted object is opened
